data.title: OceanScape Settles Director Fee Dispute as Legal Actions Continue Against Ex-Board Members
data.description:

data.title: Vee S.A. to Overhaul Reporting of Operational Metrics
data.description:
An announcement from Vee SA ( (PL:VEE) ) is now available.

Vee S.A. has announced it will stop regularly publishing data on the number of handled cases and Minutes of Processed Conversations in their current format, arguing that these volume metrics no longer adequately reflect the scale or economics of the Group’s operations. As the business model has shifted toward success-based and KPI-driven settlements, a given volume of cases or minutes can now correspond to very different economic values.

The company is developing a new approach to presenting operational data that emphasizes efficiency indicators tailored to specific campaigns and settlement models, aiming to give investors and stakeholders a clearer view of operational scale, effectiveness, and the linkage between performance and revenue. Methodology and scope for these new metrics are still being refined, and Vee plans to announce the adopted formula in a separate communication.

data.title: Jintai Energy Commits RMB2.14 Billion in Prepayments to Secure MTBE Supply
data.description:
The latest update is out from Jintai Energy Holdings Limited ( (HK:2728) ).

Jintai Energy’s subsidiary Ningxia Deru has entered into a series of procurement agreements with a supplier of methyl tert-butyl ether, committing to substantial advance payments to secure guaranteed supply of the fuel additive. From July 18, 2023 to June 30, 2026, Ningxia Deru has prepaid about RMB2.14 billion, which will be settled through product delivery and booked as inventory costs.

The agreements feature prepayments without interest or collateral and do not include a specific refund policy, underscoring the company’s reliance on long-term supply stability for its operations. This structure ties a significant amount of working capital to one supplier over a multi-year period, affecting liquidity and counterparty exposure while reinforcing Jintai Energy’s positioning in the petrochemical supply chain.
